Overview & Purpose

About Xtreme AI Browser

Xtreme AI Browser redefines how you interact with the modern web. Engineered from the ground up for power users, developers, and researchers, it seamlessly embeds Rafail AI directly into your browsing workflows. From multi-identity sandboxes and instant page summarization to script-assisted automation and native ad-blocking, Xtreme AI Browser keeps your browsing fast, isolated, and intelligent.

The Problem It Solves

Standard web browsers consume gigabytes of memory, track user activities relentlessly, and isolate AI into disjointed chat tabs. Xtreme AI Browser brings local AI assistance directly to the DOM and user viewport while enforcing strict zero-telemetry identity boundaries between your tasks.

Target Users & Utility

Developers, researchers, and privacy-conscious users seeking an AI-integrated browser with local sandboxing, multiple isolated profiles, and direct desktop automation.

Engineering Capabilities

Key Features

Rafail AI In-Browser Copilot

Summarize research papers, explain complex web documentation, extract structured data, and translate in real-time.

Multi-Identity Sandboxing

Run multiple isolated browser instances simultaneously with distinct cookies, session data, and proxy configurations.

Privacy Shield & Zero Telemetry

Aggressive tracker blocking, fingerprinting protection, and zero background analytics to protect your digital sovereignty.

Integrated Developer Toolkit

Built-in network inspection, quick script injector, and DOM telemetry designed for rapid web inspection.

Low Memory Architecture

Aggressively sleeps inactive background tabs to maintain peak system responsiveness and reduce RAM spikes.

Futuristic Dark UI

Custom-crafted interface styled in graphite, gold, and crimson with keyboard-driven commands and quick-switcher palette.

User Interface

Application Previews

Main browser window with Rafail AI sidebar assistant and quick-launch bookmarks.

Setup Procedure

Step-by-Step Installation Guide

01

Download the Official Installer

Click the primary Windows Installer button above to download the latest setup executable.

Save the installer to your Downloads folder or Desktop for easy access.
02

Run the Installer Executable

Double-click the downloaded setup file to begin the installation procedure.

Because this is an independent developer build, Windows Defender SmartScreen may display 'Windows protected your PC'. Click 'More info' and then select 'Run anyway'.
03

Select Installation Preferences

Choose your preferred destination folder and whether to create a desktop shortcut and taskbar pin.

04

Complete Setup & Launch

Click Finish to complete installation. Xtreme AI Browser will automatically launch and initiate your initial configuration.

05

Initial Configuration

Configure your initial profile name, default search engine, and toggle Rafail AI sidebar options in Settings.

Troubleshooting & Safety Verification

All applications released by Xtremerpie are compiled from authentic local source trees with zero telemetry and zero adware. If an antivirus flags the executable, verify the SHA256 checksum matching our official release notes, or report the checksum to our GitHub repository.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Q:Why does Windows SmartScreen show an unrecognized app warning?

Xtreme AI Browser is an independently developed open project. Commercial code-signing certificates cost hundreds of dollars per year. To proceed, click 'More info' and then 'Run anyway'. The application is safe, contains zero spyware, and never collects telemetry.

Q:Can I use Chrome extensions with Xtreme AI Browser?

Xtreme AI Browser is built on a Chromium-compatible foundation. Manual CRX extension loading is supported in Developer Mode, with full one-click extension store integration planned for v0.8.0.

Q:Does Rafail AI send my personal browsing data to remote servers?

No. Rafail AI only processes data when you explicitly ask it to analyze or summarize a page. In default mode, no browsing history, credentials, or personal queries are ever stored or uploaded.

Q:How do I update to the newest version?

Simply download the latest installer from this App Hub and run it over your current installation. Your profiles, bookmarks, and settings will remain completely intact.
